answer: Each agent must trade with 20 counterparties per epoch, none over 10% of volume. A sybil farm is a grove: its fakes trade only with each other, their diversity stays near zero, a canyon-wide gap below honest agents. Each identity posts 60 POA; below the bar it is slashed and it spirals into quarantine. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 20 trades each at 3 POA, 60,000, plus 60,000 in bonds. An honest agent pays 60 once and trades freely.
